summary: Iteration 4 frontend regression + new-feature testing complete on https://aerial-spectacle.preview.emergentagent.com. NEW pinned Chapters section (#povestea) works flawlessly — scrolling advances 01→02→03 (chapter-dot-0/1/2 active swap verified, chapter-media-0/1/2 crossfade verified). Bidirectional Reveal verified: service-card-0 inline opacity = 1 in-view, 0 off-screen (top), 1 again when re-entered. All 13 sections render. Showcase next/prev/tab-2, Packages CTA prefill (package-cta-2 → 'Pachet Combinat Premium'), Gallery lightbox, FAQ, mobile menu, and full Quote form flow (empty→validation toast, filled w/o consent→consent toast, with consent→quote-success persisted) all pass. NO new blocking console errors. NO horizontal overflow on 1440x900 or 390x844. Mobile Chapters fits in viewport (media y=235 h=220, number y=519 h=70, all within 844). Technology section reachable past Chapters.
critical_code_review_comments: Chapters.jsx: useScroll + useMotionValueEvent + Math.floor(v * CHAPTERS.length) correctly maps 0..1 scroll progress to 0/1/2 active index — verified empirically (dot-0→dot-1→dot-2 transitions at expected scroll positions).
Chapters section height = CHAPTERS.length * 100vh with sticky h-screen inner — produces correct pinning behavior (Chapters bottom 900 = Tech top 900 in desktop test).
Reveal.jsx uses viewport={{ once:false, margin:'-70px' }} → bidirectional fade works as designed (opacity 1↔0 transitions cleanly on enter/leave).
On mobile, Chapters right-side media uses order-first lg:order-none — verified media stacks ABOVE number/text on mobile and inside viewport (no clipping).
Home.jsx wraps main in overflow-x-hidden — confirmed 0px horizontal overflow on both desktop & mobile.
Quote form consent gating works correctly: empty triggers 'Completează' toast, filled-without-consent triggers consent toast, with consent submits successfully and shows quote-success.
